description.purpose: The one command channel to the media edge: a GET at FreeSWITCH's `mod_xml_rpc` endpoint, `/webapi/originate` and `/webapi/uuid_kill`. The URL is composed by the cell beside it and travels in the tool_call, because a fetcher with a target baked in would be a fetcher for one caller.
description.use_when: Inside this channel only, and only for the two commands the signalling half composes. `allow_private_networks` is on because a media edge lives on the same LAN as the colony; a switch on the public internet is not the shape this template is for.
description.not_in_scope: It does not know what a call is. A `-ERR` from the switch is a normal answer here, carrying HTTP 200 -- the cell beside it reads the text and decides. And it follows no redirect: a control endpoint that answers 302 is not the endpoint that was asked for.
description.emits_meaning: messages[]: one tool_result turn whose text is the switch's answer -- `+OK <uuid>` or `-ERR <reason>`. hop.http_status carries the answer's status; error_code is set only for io_error, timeout, invalid_input, target_blocked and invalid_redirect.
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: a tool_call turn whose text is the JSON args {url}, composed by the signalling half.
examples: originate answered '+OK 1234-…' -> nothing follows: the ANSWER of a call is the dialplan's own event
originate answered '-ERR NO_ANSWER' -> the row goes to no_answer and a turn says so
the switch unreachable -> error_code io_error, and the same turn with `failed`
